Answer: C) The consolidations are equally distributed in both mid and lower zones of both lungs, correlating with severe COVID-19 pneumonia.  
Reason: Figure 1a (PA CXR) shows bilateral, patchy opacities predominantly in the mid and lower lung zones with relative sparing of the upper zones; the lateral view (Figure 1b) confirms posteriorly located consolidations in both lungs, consistent with a symmetric, diffuse pattern typical of severe COVID-19 pneumonia—not unilateral or upper-lobe predominant.
